biography.plain_text: Nikolaos Vafias is a Greek shipowner who founded Brave Maritime. The son of a successful meat trader, he studied economics in Athens and used earnings from the meat market to enter shipping with a fellow student. His business developed from dry cargo into tankers and vessels carrying liquefied petroleum gas.

long_biography.plain_text:
Nikolaos Vafias built a second phase of his shipping career around buying vessels when markets were depressed. After handing daily management to his son Harry and spending several years away, he returned through Eco Dry Ventures. In 2016, he bought two large bulk carriers and resold them within months at a substantial gain. Later purchases extended his interests into different sizes of gas carrier.

Outside shipping, he helped establish Hara, a residential charity in Pallini for people with disabilities, and serves as its treasurer. The association combines residential care with therapy and draws funding from families, public health payments and private donations.

uncertainties: Research cutoff is 30 September 2026; access occurred on 1 October. Current-sector and relationship judgments use positive retained-ownership evidence, with incomplete personal asset weights disclosed.

The input lists Theion historically through 2016. The reproduced interview identifies the family's 31m Baglietto Robusto; the independent former-name records connect that hull to Theion. This supports identity but is not a legal beneficial-ownership determination or independent verification of the exact end date.

An apparent second Nikolaos Th. Vafias in search results proved an indexing concatenation: the full UGS board list names Harry N. Vafias followed by Nikolaos Th. Veniamis. The son and father are kept separate throughout.

The primary Hara biography is undated and its companion institutional page contains a future 2021 extension reference. Its ownership description is therefore combined with later trade and 2026 issuer evidence, not treated as a dated 2026 personal balance sheet.

Father Charalambos's wealth and Nikolaos's earned work are both documented. Direct accounts describe paternal opposition and a partner/bank loan; no principal inherited meat-company interest is established. Indirect family security is plausible but does not settle a narrow subtype. Broad Self-made is deliberately retained.

Investor is the strongest relationship alternative given his market trading and delegated management. Founder better captures continuing economic ownership in his created operating platform; precise roles and personal percentages remain unavailable.

No personal fleet, issuer capitalization or group transaction total is used as his net worth. SEC joint holdings with Theano and gifts to Harry were considered as supporting family context but are not needed to establish principal personal materiality and are not imported as individual totals.

All person-relevant social types were checked in English and Greek: LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube and TikTok. Results chiefly concern son Harry, third-party posts and a bare LinkedIn directory namesake. No authenticated personal profile was established. TikTok direct access is robot-blocked.

Forbes, Wikipedia, Company Website, Vimeo, Flickr, Trip Advisor and Zillow were also checked. No suitable verified personal profile was found. The historic vafiasgroup.gr/brave address was unavailable; a directory or a son's listed-company website is not substituted.

No reliable precise birth date or birthplace was established. The father's Chios origins are not automatically the owner's birthplace. Patronymic initials vary between Ch. and H.; no middle-name expansion is proposed.

Source bodies were read publicly as specified in each ledger entry. The SYT identity passage and relevant 2026 SEC sections were available substantively through indexed content; no entire-filing or inaccessible-page read is claimed.
